title: Cross-project graph edge endpoints
description: WHY: portfolio containers (sprint G7) need edges whose endpoints live in different workspaces - a global initiative blocked by a work item inside a linked project. WHAT: additive optional fromProjectId and toProjectId fields on GraphEdge (packages/core/src/records.ts lines 199-207), threaded through createGraphEdge in @boreal/graph-engine, the graph-edge JSON schema (schemas/records/graph-edge.schema.json), and cycle detection (wouldCreateCycle must treat qualified and local endpoints consistently - a local edge is shorthand for same-project). Local-only behavior is bit-for-bit unchanged when the fields are absent; state files without the fields load unmodified. Do not implement cross-boundary readiness derivation here - that is sprint G7; this task only makes the edges representable and validated.
acceptanceCriteria: Edges with cross-project endpoints round-trip through the store and schema validation
All existing graph and dependency tests pass unmodified
Cycle detection handles mixed local and qualified endpoints, covered by tests
closedReason: Cross-project graph edge endpoint support is implemented, validated, and checkpointed.
